answers.q: What do mitochondria produce, and what is special about their DNA?
answers.ref: ATP, through oxidative phosphorylation; they carry their own circular DNA, inherited from the mother.
answers.a: They make ATP by oxidative phosphorylation, and they have their own circular DNA that comes from your mother.
